items.title: Netflix co-CEO says streaming giant "isn't growing as fast as I want us to"
items.summary: Netflix Inc (NASDAQ:NFLX, XETRA:NFC) co-CEO Ted Sarandos said the streaming giant is not growing as fast as he would like, with viewership up just 2% in the first half of 2026. "Overall, we're not growing as fast as I want us to," Sarandos said at Bloomberg's 2026 Screentime event in Los...

items.title: Shares of Media Companies Fall After Paramount Gets Closer to Warner Acquisition
items.summary: Shares of media companies are in the doldrums today. The declines come after a federal judge on Wednesday afternoon approved Paramount's settlement with 12 state attorneys general, resolving an antitrust case and paving the way for its $81-billion acquisition of Warner Bros.
